856-5776-6277-6797.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

277-1021-5226-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead trigger.

Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.

1308-3129-4772-6664-7942.description:

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

1987-3120-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3120-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3120-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-3291-6965.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-6965.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2999-3197-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3197-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7706.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1368-2033-4742-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-4742-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

924-4149-4599-4871-7297.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4871-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4871-7297.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4871-7297.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

240-3967-4875.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-3967-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

372-2556-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2556-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

546-4613-5900-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 5 or greater.
546-4613-5900-7233.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Inferno Project. Inferno Project enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Inferno Project using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

4452-5310-5686-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-5310-5686-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2103-6122-6927.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Damage Control Crew by paying its mana cost.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Damage Control Crew from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

725-2034-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 2 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
725-2034-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.

500-1270-2523-2557.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Ojer Taq token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Ojer Taqs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2*(3^X) nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Ojer Taqs you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-1270-2523-2557.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^695.6224481408007) creature tokens.

225-1170-1418-4124-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1418-4124-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1719-4639-5475.notablePrerequisites: Forensic Researcher and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
1719-4639-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Forensic Researcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

719-1238-2351-5231-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

2178-4050-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4050-4170-4871.description:

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Inkling, adding one mana of any color.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

3057-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have a way to give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance.
3057-5703-5929.description:
Give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance by any method.
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Bloodthirster from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Leyline of Transformation, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Bloodthirster token.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

1142-1429-2012-2034.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Lesser Masticore if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Strangleroot Geist otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Lesser Masticore, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

1235-4863-5026-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, targeting Twinflame.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Reverberate, creating a copy of Twinflame, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reverberate to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
After the first iteration, you may instead target Revolutionist and any other creature you control using the Twinflame copies.

628-914-2292-4153.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Dockside Extortionist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-914-2292-4153.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Dockside Extortionist onto another permanent you control.
Repeat.
If opponents control six or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

986-1526-4499-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
986-1526-4499-4918.description:
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Electrostatic Pummeler.
Electrostatic Pummeler enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Lightning Runner ability from step 1, causing you to get {E}{E}, then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1661-1872-3003-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1661-1872-3003-5220.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Composite Golem dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Composite Golem on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem from the top of your library by paying at most {4}.
Repeat.

1110-3760.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Broodhatch Nantuko indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
1110-3760.description:
Give Broodhatch Nantuko indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
Broodhatch Nantuko triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 1 damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
Repeat from step 3.
